baseline_coin.accuracy_note: Not a measured quantity: the coin predicts p=0.5 for every match, so its accuracy is 0.5 in expectation by symmetry. A computed value under a deterministic tie rule would just restate the sample's team_1 win share (S2: 0.34375), which is why it is null.

notes: S2 walk-forward; priors as of 2025-11-17; XI = actual XI (the live P1 is also post-XI-announcement). The fitted logistic LOSES to Elo on this backtest and its Platt slope is negative -- it ships as challenger only. The champion blend ties Elo (no demonstrated gain). S3 frozen log is the decisive evaluation.
